description: This file contains the implementation of the Wishlist model class in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines methods to add, delete, retrieve, and count wishlist items for customers.

classes.name: Wishlist
classes.description: A model class managing customer wishlist operations such as adding, deleting, fetching, and counting wishlist items in the database.

methods.name: addWishlist
methods.description: Adds a product to the customer's wishlist by inserting a record into the database after deleting any existing entry for the same product.

methods.name: deleteWishlist
methods.description: Removes a product from the customer's wishlist; optionally filters by product ID.

methods.name: getWishlist
methods.description: Retrieves all wishlist items for a specific customer.

methods.name: getTotalWishlist
methods.description: Returns the total number of wishlist items for a customer.
